headline: Kodak Posts Stronger Q3 2026 Results as Shares Fall After Hours
summary: Eastman Kodak reported stronger third-quarter 2026 results during its earnings call, while its shares declined in after-hours trading.
why: Earnings reports provide key fundamental data on historical revenue and profitability for legacy technology and manufacturing companies.

impacts.name: Eastman Kodak Company
impacts.why: Shares fell after hours despite stronger third-quarter results.
